summary: Keep private daemon gateways away from the shared default socket.

replay.detail: No claim replay or projection recovery changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or digest rule change.

compatibility.detail: Private --state-dir takes precedence over --socket when deriving the paired gateway. Socket-only startup refuses if its derived gateway equals the shared default, resolving existing parent-directory symlinks. Explicit --client-gateway-socket and default startup are unchanged.

manual.detail: For a private socket beside the shared default gateway without --state-dir, pass --client-gateway-socket with a private path.

recovery.detail: No persisted migration; ordinary binary rollback restores the previous gateway derivation.

downtime.detail: Normal daemon restart; duration not measured for this change.
